categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/index/base.cpp` and index unit tests to alter how `BaseIndex` processes chainstate flush notifications.
categories.rationale: Fixes a crash regression where pruned nodes running secondary indexes abort when assumeutxo background validation completes. Skipped flushes left the index tip so far behind that required blocks were pruned before indexing finished (issue #36939).

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Does not touch validation code; changes are confined to `src/index/` which validation explicitly excludes.
categories.rationale: The PR modifies only the `BaseIndex` framework in `src/index/base.cpp`, which belongs strictly to the indexes category despite interacting with chainstate notifications.
